name: tovu-deploy-fly
description: Deploys a Tovu instance to fly.io with no CLI installed anywhere — the assistant writes a fly.toml and a GitHub Actions workflow into the operator's repo, then fires it through the workspace's saved GitHub credential, so flyctl only ever runs on GitHub's runner. Encodes the four Tovu-specific rules generic fly.io knowledge gets wrong: exactly one machine (SQLite), the volume shadowing the image's entire sites/ tree, secrets never in fly.toml, and deploying shipping code rather than content.
author: Tovu
